about: Every command registered by Obsidian 1.14.4 desktop (Windows) with all 30 core plugins switched on, measured at runtime from app.commands. Facts only. "Mod" means Ctrl on Windows/Linux and Cmd on macOS. Commands with an empty defaultHotkeys list have no default hotkey. Basic text editing keys (undo, redo, arrows, Enter, Tab, Home/End, selection) are handled by the editor keymap, not by commands, and are not listed here.
